notes: You can now see what changed in each update.
Open More, then About, then What's new for the full version history.
Odometer: a day that's already logged now shows a calm Saved button instead of a fresh one, and the day's distance stands out clearly.
Odometer: shows Location on file when a reading already has GPS, instead of a wrong No location.
New photo picker with clear Camera and Gallery buttons.
Visit check-in and check-out now show a map of the location being captured.
Call history tabs scroll sideways, so Skipped is no longer cut off.
Updates now download with a progress bar and the file size.
The after-call outcome prompt is on by default for everyone.
Tapping a log-your-call reminder opens that exact call.
New Internal tab in call history for colleague calls.
Log a call outcome in one tap from the Needs-outcome list.
Stability fixes and small polish.
Live team status, a home-screen team widget, and WhatsApp message templates.
Mark colleague calls as Internal, with a dedicated Internal view and manager stats.
Phone navigation bar now matches the app theme.
Call quality score, an open-actions digest, and do-not-disturb screening.
Edit a call summary right on the transcript screen.
More accurate call summaries.
Clearer call audio for better transcription.
